alt: A smiling woman in a blue uniform stands beside a large, intricate chocolate sculpture of a tortoise carrying a tree with carved animals on its trunk.
A smiling woman with dark hair stands next to a large, multi-tiered chocolate sculpture of wolves, with a sign at the base reading "Curse of Dark Castle."
A smiling woman with dark hair poses behind a large, brown dinosaur cake decorated with white teeth and a red octopus topper, set against a backdrop featuring a sign with the word "FOOD."

A detailed chocolate sculpture of three wolves in dynamic poses, with one howling at the top, stands on a wooden surface in front of a pink backdrop featuring a sign that reads "The" and a logo for "Cacao Darkastle."
